ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 cancellation fee to the rider and remind the driver of his arrival/contact obligations; no account flag (first such incident, no arrival fraud proven).
ruling.reasoning:
The rider booked for 09:52 and cancelled at 10:00 (8 minutes later). The GPS track shows the driver was nowhere near the pickup: his last sample at 10:00 is at 1.38785, 103.98265 (Loyang Avenue), roughly 3.3 km from Pasir Ris MRT (1.373, 103.9492), moving away along Loyang Avenue/Changi Village Road — never within 200 m of the pickup point, and with no "I'm Here" / auto-arrival event. He also sent no in-app message and made no call; the only chat messages are the rider's. That is the driver failing to arrive.

NS-0 routes this to NS-8 (driver did not arrive), not NS-1 (no-show) — the driver never cancelled and was never at the pickup. Under NS-8 the rider may cancel free from scheduled time + 5 minutes (09:57); she cancelled at 10:00, so the $5.00 fee is voided: refund_full of $5.00. NS-8's extra $5.00 goodwill credit is not triggered because the driver did attempt contact: his statement ("Traffic was very heavy on the way to the pickup") and the speed-band record (Loyang Avenue, band 2 / 10–19 km/h) show he was genuinely en route and slowed, even if that does not excuse non-arrival by 09:57. His statement does not salvage the fee under NS-1 either, since no NS-1 condition (arrival, wait, message + call) is met.

No route-deviation or surge element exists: the trip never started, actual distance 0.0 km, fare $0.00. The driver already has two upheld no-show findings in 90 days, but neither NS-2's arrival-fraud trigger nor RD-6 applies here, so no flag_account. Safety screen: no threat, harassment, dangerous-driving allegation or sexual remark in the complaint, statement or chats — safety_concern none. TH-2: no-show/cancellation is a $5.00 system-final category. Precedent DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel, zero contact, $5.00 refunded) supports the outcome; here there was some driver contact by statement, so only the fee is refunded, no goodwill credit.

element_findings.element: Which clause applies: driver cancelled for no-show (NS-1/NS-2) vs driver did not arrive (NS-8)
element_findings.reason: Cancelled_by = rider for 'driver_taking_too_long'; driver's last GPS sample at 10:00 is ~3.3 km from the pickup point (Loyang Avenue), no 'I'm Here'/auto-arrival event, so the driver never arrived. NS-0 -> NS-8.

element_findings.element: NS-1 conditions (arrival within 200 m, wait period, >=1 message + >=1 call, presence at pickup)
element_findings.reason: Driver never pressed 'I'm Here' and was never within 200 m of Pasir Ris MRT; no driver chat message or call logged. The $5.00 fee cannot stand.

element_findings.element: NS-8 driver contact attempt (for the $5.00 goodwill credit)
element_findings.reason: Driver's statement and the Loyang Avenue speed-band 2 record (10–19 km/h) indicate he was en route and delayed rather than ignoring the trip, so no goodwill credit is added.

rejected_claims.reason: Heavy traffic (Loyang Avenue speed band 2) explains the delay but does not satisfy NS-1 (no arrival, no message, no call); the rider's free cancellation at scheduled+5 min under NS-8 stands.

The rider's characterisation is accepted as to the outcome, but the $5.00 fee is voided under NS-8 rather than because 'nobody contacted her' — the driver did attempt contact (statement + traffic record).
